stackDivergence.rationale: Actual RTL/UNO owners retain source contracts. Explicit scope destruction and counted views bind logical address storage; physical C++ ABI, native logging/mutex/allocator and complete application parity remain unqualified.

preservedResponsibilities: Original ParserData cached native references, Event actual RTL/attribute owners, SaxContext token-dependent optional values and Entity callback/first-exception consumers. InputSource/converter/shared-event/raw parser-pointer/default thread fields now belong to this same real Entity; the older standalone input Entity is removed. Real registered Writer/token services and original legacy adapters exercise known/unknown/root/child/null/namespace/text/end/PI paths, copied cache lifetime and real closed-stream failures. Actual native UNO exception capture preserves first error and callback unwinding. No fake document handler/provider, private-state patch or arbitrary numeric-result injection. Source input/converter ownership is shared with the existing host reader, not mirrored in a second entity.

Added original NameWithToken/NamespaceDefine owned values and actual namespace/default stacks, valid-count stack and backing-definition vector fields to the same Entity; active-prefix fixtures initialize these public original aggregates explicitly. The new separate actual FastSaxParserImpl/locator owner is partial; four native C producers now populate these same fields; stream/custom-entity/service assembly remains unported.

Original Entity::throwException and lclGetErrorMessage now prepare actual source SAXParseException values from native C diagnostics, source ASCII_US decoding/fallback/prefix, native locator identifiers/positions and first caught Any through real CPPU assignment. Native Any operand copying flattens through the original shared copy owner; no invented nested wrapper. Actual nil-handler and real registered Writer/closed-stream failures are tested, including saved-exception equality. Fatal-handler callbacks preserve original typed Any, exception unwind and unconditional throw, but nonnull handler execution/native threaded-phase suppression/physical mutex behavior remain unqualified; no replacement positive handler is supplied.
omittedResponsibilities: Full FastSaxParserImpl stream/custom-entity/service assembly, original parser QA, non-Emscripten queue/thread mechanisms and complete model/filter/UI acceptance remain unported. Actual native locator and partial parser configuration/stack/namespace registry are now separate ported source owners. Current Emscripten profile source disables internal threading. Source SAL logging, non-UNO host exception ABI and physical C++ ABI/mutex/allocation remain unqualified.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original private value/context/adapter responsibilities are split from their pinned translation unit without changing actual receiver identity, ownership or introducing alternate parser state. The complete parser/service remains a separate unfinished responsibility.
